source.title: Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Lurgan Rural Council": nominations received by W. J. Corner, deputy returning officer)
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten Co. Armagh divisions, two councillors each), polled 28 May 1914: contests only in Cornakinnegar and Portadown Rural. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Two seats: John Robinson was "the only bona-fide nomination", and one of the retiring members, George W. Annesley or Henry Kingsborough, "will be called on to fill the vacancy" (Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1914, p. 5). Which of them took the second seat was not found, so only Robinson is filed.
